label: Plastic Dreams homage — 92 organ house
palette:
# Plastic Dreams homage — DEVELOPED (organ riff dense & syncopated)
# drums + seed-style lines are 1-bar (16, repeat); bass/organ VARY over 4 bars (64).
# 'organ' is aliased to 'lead' in this build — see meta.organNote.
kick:  x ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ ~
chh:   ~ ~ x ~  ~ ~ x ~  ~ ~ x ~  ~ ~ x ~
ohh:   ~ x ~ ~  ~ x ~ ~  ~ x ~ ~  ~ x ~ ~
clap:  ~ ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ ~  ~ ~ ~ ~  x ~ ~ ~
chord: c3+eb3+g3  c3+eb3+g3  bb2+d3+f3  g2+bb2+d3  /16
bass:  c2 ~ c2 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ c2 ~ c2 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ f1 ~ f1 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ d1 ~ d1 ~  /2
lead:  c4 eb4 g4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4 g4 c5 bb4 g4 c5 eb4 d4 c4 ~ c4 g4 eb4 c4 d4 eb4 g4 bb4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4 g4 f4 eb4 d4 d4 f4 bb4 d5 c5 bb4 f4 d4 bb3 d4 f4 bb4 f4 d4 c4 ~ g4 bb4 d5 g5 f5 d5 bb4 g4 d4 g4 bb4 d5 bb4 g4 f4 ~  /1
arrangement:
@length 64

0   section seed                 ; STATE A — bare groove, sparse organ
0   in kick
0   in bass
4   in ohh

8   section groove
8   in clap
# 'organ' interpolation stages — each is a 'set lead ...' frame (organ aliased to lead).
# Sparse stages are 1-bar (16) loops by design; the final full frame is the 4-bar (64) phrase.
12  set lead c4 ~ eb4 ~ g4 ~ ~ ~ c4 ~ bb3 ~ g3 ~ ~ ~ /1        ; stage 0 (seed, 1-bar loop)

16  section interp-1
16  in chord
16  set lead c4 ~ eb4 g4 ~ bb4 ~ ~ c4 ~ bb3 g3 ~ eb4 ~ ~ /1   ; stage 1: gaps filling (1-bar)

24  section interp-2
24  in chh
24  set lead c4 eb4 g4 ~ bb4 g4 ~ eb4 c5 ~ bb4 g4 f4 ~ eb4 ~ /1 ; stage 2: rolling (1-bar)

32  section full                                                ; STATE B — full 4-bar improvised riff
32  set lead c4 eb4 g4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4 g4 c5 bb4 g4 c5 eb4 d4 c4 ~ c4 g4 eb4 c4 d4 eb4 g4 bb4 c5 bb4 g4 eb4 g4 f4 eb4 d4 d4 f4 bb4 d5 c5 bb4 f4 d4 bb3 d4 f4 bb4 f4 d4 c4 ~ g4 bb4 d5 g5 f5 d5 bb4 g4 d4 g4 bb4 d5 bb4 g4 f4 ~ /1
32  set bass  c2 ~ c2 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ c2 ~ c2 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ bb1 ~ bb1 ~ f1 ~ f1 ~ g1 ~ g1 ~ d1 ~ d1 ~ /2

44  section breakdown
44  out kick
44  out clap
44  filter 900 6
# 'organ' keeps rolling alone over the filtered pad — the 'jazzy interlude'

54  section riser
54  riser 8
54  filter 18000 4
58  in kick
58  in clap
# bar 64 loops -> full groove + dense organ slams back = the drop
# NET EFFECT: organ riff interpolates seed->dense across bars 12->32, exactly the
# slow-unfurling 'improvised' build the original rides for ~10 minutes.

meta.title: Plastic Dreams (homage)
meta.inspiration: Jaydee — 'Plastic Dreams' (1992, R&S Records). Robin Albers / DJ Jaydee.
meta.COPYRIGHT_NOTE: Plastic Dreams is a COPYRIGHTED 1992 work, NOT public domain (unlike the Chaconne / Greensleeves presets). This preset does NOT transcribe Albers's organ riff. It reproduces only (a) the generic four-on-the-floor house drum convention, which is an uncopyrightable genre idiom, and (b) an ORIGINAL rolling-organ pattern written to evoke the jazzy/improvised Hammond CHARACTER described in sources — not its melody. Treat as 'in the spirit of', a homage, not a copy. If shipping publicly, label it as inspired-by, not a cover.
meta.timeFeel: 4/4 straight, house. Swing optional (engine has no swing).
meta.signatureElement: rolling, syncopated organ riff over a stripped four-on-the-floor
meta.organNote: The studio engine has no 'organ' voice — this preset aliases 'organ' to 'lead' (the studio's brightest sustained synth). The riff is the point; the timbre name is not. The dense-rolling lead line is intentionally voiced as a supersaw-on-the-lead bus; getting closer to a Hammond drawbar would need a synth-design change in the voice code.

harmonyReference.tonalCenter: C minor / C dorian (the riff leans on c eb g bb, with d and f as passing/dorian color)
harmonyReference.organPitchSet: c eb f g bb (+ passing d) — C minor pentatonic with a dorian-ish 6th flavor
harmonyReference.bassMove: root pulse on the seed (c every beat), opening to c-g-bb-g walk in the developed state

interpolationModel.what: Two palette STATES (initial seed A, developed B) plus an arrangement that linearly swaps the organ pattern through intermediate densities (stage 0->1->2->full).
interpolationModel.knob: The 'set lead ...' lines at bars 12/16/24/32 are the interpolation frames. Add or remove frames to make the morph slower/faster.
interpolationModel.why_set_not_crossfade: The studio mutates patterns discretely on bar boundaries, so interpolation is stepped (4 stages), not continuous.
interpolationModel.alt_continuous: True continuous interpolation (probabilistic note-density ramp) would need an engine feature: a per-track 'density' param 0..1 that stochastically gates steps. NOT built; flagged as a possible studio enhancement.

caveats.copyright: See meta.COPYRIGHT_NOTE. Original work is under copyright; this is an inspired-by homage. Do not market as a cover/transcription.
caveats.keyAmbiguity: Catalog sites disagree (C major vs minor). The hook reads dark/minor; this preset commits to C minor. For the brighter reading, raise eb->e and bb->b in lead/chord.
caveats.swing: House sits slightly behind the grid. The studio's straight 16th grid can't swing without a transport feature.
caveats.organTimbre: Hammond/jazz-organ tone is a SYNTH-VOICE concern, not a pattern concern. Pattern captures the rhythm/notes; matching the timbre is a voice-design task in the studio.
caveats.cymaticsCoupling: The seed->dense organ interpolation steadily raises mid/treble energy and note rate, so the cymatics field tightens and climbs through the build automatically.
